sloka: वार्यमाणाः सुबहुशो वेष्टन्त्यः क्षितिपांसुषु ।विमुक्तकेश्यो दुःखार्ता गावो वत्सहता इव ।। ६.११३.२ ।।
transliteration: vāryamāṇāḥ subahuśo veṣṭantyaḥ kṣitipāṁsuṣu ।vimuktakeśyo duḥkhārtā gāvo vatsahatā iva ।। 6.113.2 ।।

translations.english: Numerous women, though obstructed, were rolling in dust, with dishevelled hair and crying like cows which had lost their calves.
